violated_contract: A sign-in that replaces the current session must hold the replacement credential before it ends the old session, and a user closing the provider's sheet is a neutral outcome, not a failure. Native iOS Apple sign-in signed the current user out before presenting the Apple sheet, so closing the sheet ended an existing session; the cancellation then came back as null like a failure and showed 'Failed to sign in with Apple'.
canonical_prevention: Request and validate the provider credential first, and run the account-switch sign-out only between credential acquisition and the Firebase sign-in that consumes it. Carry user cancellation as a distinct signal (the provider's canceled error, rethrown) so callers skip failure copy for it while real failures keep theirs. A unit test drives the flow through injected credential and Firebase sign-in seams and asserts that a closed sheet leaves the session untouched and shows no failure toast.
